Class ATopLevelBlock

java.lang.Object
solvers.linearSystem.btf.ComponentBlock
solvers.linearSystem.btf.topLevelBlocks.TopLevelBlock
solvers.linearSystem.btf.topLevelBlocks.ATopLevelBlock
Direct Known Subclasses:
XBlock, YBlock
public abstract class ATopLevelBlock extends TopLevelBlock
This class extends TopLevelBlock to also include a list of SecondaryMacroBlocks. This is required of the two blocks of the A matrix: XBlock and YBlock
Author:
Jack Bradshaw
